dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: How was the night market with your sister?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ wʌz ðə ˈnaɪt ˌmɑːrkɪt wɪð jʊr ˈsɪstər?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Busy! The sellers were all shouting, "Two for a hundred! Two for a hundred!"
dialogue.reading: ˈbɪzi! ðə ˈsɛlərz wɜːr ˈɔːl ˈʃaʊtɪŋ, ˈtuː fər ə ˈhʌndrəd! ˈtuː fər ə ˈhʌndrəd!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Fah saw a puppy at a pet stall. "Please, please buy it for me!" she begged.
dialogue.reading: ˈfɑː ˈsɔː ə ˈpʌpi ət ə ˈpɛt ˈstɔːl. ˈpliːz, ˈpliːz ˈbaɪ ɪt fər miː! ʃiː ˈbɛɡd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Oh no. What did you say?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ. ˈwʌt dɪd juː ˈseɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: "Mom won't let you keep a dog," I said. But Fah insisted, "She will! I'll take care of it!"
dialogue.reading: ˈmɑːm ˈwoʊnt ˈlɛt juː ˈkiːp ə ˈdɔːɡ, aɪ ˈsɛd. bʌt ˈfɑː ɪnˈsɪstɪd, ʃiː ˈwɪl! aɪl ˈteɪk ˈkɛr əv ɪt!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No. I sighed and said, "OK, let's call Mom." Mom answered and shouted, "No dogs!"
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ. aɪ ˈsaɪd ənd ˈsɛd, oʊˈkeɪ, ˈlɛts ˈkɔːl ˈmɑːm. ˈmɑːm ˈænsərd ənd ˈʃaʊtɪd, ˈnoʊ ˈdɔːɡz!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Then, just as we were leaving, the seller called out, "Wait! Half price for you!"
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn, dʒʌst əz wiː wɜːr ˈliːvɪŋ, ðə ˈsɛlər ˈkɔːld ˈaʊt, ˈweɪt! ˈhæf ˈpraɪs fər juː!
